messages:
maria: Pushed a new embedding candidate (opal-mini) to staging and ran a k-fold roundtrip on our knn index. Quick high-level: avg recall@10 down ~0.8% vs baseline, cluster centroids shifted for a couple slices. Need help triaging.

kevin: Which baseline are you comparing to? last-prod or harbor-v1? And was any quant applied?

maria: baseline = harbor-v1 float32. Candidate was opal-mini with int8 per-channel dynamic. 5-fold holdout, ~50k sample queries across web+wiki slices.

sasha: Can you drop the recall/silhouette numbers here? and any short-query slices?

maria: copy/paste small table: 
```
recall@1: baseline 0.742 -> opal-mini 0.731
recall@5: 0.862 -> 0.854
recall@10: 0.913 -> 0.905
silhouette: baseline 0.29 -> opal-mini 0.24
```

benchbot: Auto-bench uploaded artifacts: https://intra/redwood/bench/2101122334-opal-mini-kfold. latency median 1.8ms/token (p4d), vector mem ~6.2GB for the payload.

raj: silhouette drop is a red flag. Could it be we forgot to L2-normalize before indexing? That would compress inter-cluster distances.

maria: Good catch — I accidentally set normalize=False in the index pipeline for that run. Re-ran with normalize=True: recall@10 -> 0.909, silhouette -> 0.27. New artifact: https://intra/redwood/bench/2101122334-opal-mini-normalized

kevin: Nice improvement. How do short queries look (<4 tokens)? we saw regressions for compact models last month.

maria: short-query slice still shows -1.2% recall@1. Looking into tokenization effects / stopword weighting.

lee: Might be embedding collapse for tiny contexts. Try mean-token pooling instead of CLS or combine pooling strategies.

sasha: Also run a label-flip audit: sample N=200 of top1 changes vs baseline and manually check semantic inversion rate. If flips are paraphrase-preserving that's ok.

maria: Ran the flip audit: 200 flips -> 17 semantic inversions on manual review. Most flips are borderline paraphrase cases not catastrophic.

benchbot: Added UMAP clustering viz to the artifact bundle: https://intra/redwood/bench/2101122334-opal-mini-kfold/umap-opal-mini.html

raj: Proposal: run a small quant sweep tonight — int8 per-channel, int8 per-tensor, int4 GPTQ. Evaluate recall@1/5/10, silhouette, and short-query slice. If int4 fails, try hybrid fp16 for first N layers.

maria: Scheduling the sweep on staging tonight. Will include a per-slice breakdown + beefed up regression alerts for short queries.

kevin: Thanks. If int4 is noisy we should consider per-layer mixed precision as you said. Also capture nearest-neighbor distance deltas to detect embedding collapse.

sasha: Action items: create PR with eval harness + include UMAP, add normalize flag to index config, add short-query slice to regression alerts, and add nearest-neighbor delta metric.

maria: Draft PR is up: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/432 — pinged reviewers in the PR description.

lee: LGTM, please add a quick note on which inference kernels were used for each quant run (so perf vs accuracy is traceable).

maria: Will add kernel metadata + a short summary to the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
